monsters.name: Giant Rat
monsters.description: An oversized rat with matted fur and yellow teeth.

monsters.name: Lean Timber Wolf
monsters.description: A thin but aggressive wolf with a matted grey coat.

monsters.name: Forest Boar
monsters.description: A heavy-shouldered boar with sharp tusks and an irritable temper.

monsters.name: Roadside Bandit
monsters.description: A rough-looking man with a short blade and desperate eyes.

monsters.name: Webspinner Spider
monsters.description: A large spider that drops silently from the branches above.

monsters.name: Restless Skeleton
monsters.description: Bones held together by faded magic. Empty sockets still somehow watch you.

monsters.name: Alpha Timber Wolf
monsters.description: A larger, scarred wolf that leads the pack. Its growls are deeper and more confident.

monsters.name: Veteran Bandit
monsters.description: A hardened outlaw with better gear and the scars to prove experience.

monsters.name: Pale Wraith
monsters.description: A translucent figure that drifts rather than walks. The air grows cold near it.

monsters.name: Twisted Forest Guardian
monsters.description: A once-protective spirit of the woods, now warped and hostile. Bark-like skin and glowing eyes.

monsters.name: Hooded Cultist
monsters.description: A figure in dark robes murmuring under their breath. Power gathers around their hands.
